name: Matrix multiply (C)
story: Triple loop over doubles. Tune found a pipeline with vector width 4 and smaller unroll counts: 1.66x faster than -O3, confirmed.

name: Recursive Fibonacci (C++)
story: Deep recursion. Tune ships 1.14-1.23x; predict recommends a change here (predicted 1.17x, measured 1.225x on the test set).

name: Interpreter loop (C)
story: An interpreter. -O3's SimplifyCFG merges the 31 dispatch jumps into one, so branch prediction fails; turning off sink-common-insts restores them (up to 3.7x in the search).

name: Heapsort (C)
story: Longer-running program (~2.3 s at -O3). The Phase 5 search validated 1.30x. Takes a few minutes in tune.

name: Branchy integer code (C)
story: Branch-heavy integer code. Often nothing beats -O3 here; the run shows the -O3 fallback working.
